text:
Alex Chen: Heads up — I'm sketching a plan to deprecate v1 routing defaults next quarter. Need a quick sync on fallback routing, quota impact, and console signals.
Priya Singh: 👍 can you outline the user-visible changes?
Alex Chen: Root changes: 1) default route switches to v2 for unversioned tokens. 2) v1 stays live for 6mo behind a tenant flag + an automatic soft-fallback for clients that explicitly request v1 but hit capacity. 3) Console banner + telemetry to show who is still on v1.
Marcus Lopez: Soft-fallback = automatically route to v2-compatible variant when v1 is overloaded? Any transforms needed for responses?
Alex Chen: Exactly. We plan to route requests to v2-compat model variant that preserves wire shape. No semantic rewrites; just header-based opt-in/opt-out.
Dana Park: From PM side: need clear console messaging and opt-out path for enterprise (SLA customers). Banner should show estimated % traffic on v1 per tenant and a quick opt-exempt toggle.
Priya Singh: Telemetry questions: how do we measure regressions vs expected model diffs? We need token-level diffs + per-prompt signal sets.
telem-bot: Proposed metric set: [v1_request_count, v2_request_count, fallback_count, fallback_latency_p90, semantic_regressions_alerts]. Will emit as namespace redwood.compat.*
Marcus Lopez: Related quota concern: routing v2 by default might increase token consumption for some workloads (v2 tends to produce longer outputs). We should include a preflight sampling mode that calculates projected token delta per tenant.
Alex Chen: Good point. Proposal: before tenant is auto-switched, run a 24h shadow sampling that mirrors a small % of their requests to v2 and estimates token delta and latency impact. Add that to the console migration preview.
Priya Singh: UI: migration preview card with three numbers: estimated cost delta, estimated latency delta, and % of prompts flagged with template mismatches. Add an action: run shadow now.
Dana Park: Enterprise opt-outs: we ship a tenant-level `compat.exempt` flag in the console and API. Legal/Security customers can set it and request manual migration windows.
Marcus Lopez: Ops: what happens when fallback_count spikes? We need circuit breakers. Suggest: if fallback_count > 1% of total for 5m, escalate and start rate-limit backpressure to preserve latency SLOs. Also emit alert to #eng-oncall.
Alex Chen: Agree. The rollout plan should include these triggers. Also thinking of adding a weighted rollout — start with 1% of tenants, then 10%, 50%, 100% across 8 weeks.
Priya Singh: For telemetry, we need to track migration cohorts. Add tags: migration_cohort:<id>, shadow_run_id. That will let us compute regressions per cohort.
telem-bot: Note: existing metric backfill required. Will tag historical v1 traffic as cohort 0.
Marcus Lopez: Console UX detail: show a per-route breakdown (per-api-route) because some routes (embeddings, rerank) behave differently. We should allow per-route opt-ins.
Dana Park: Product requests: surface recommended actions — e.g., "Run sample shadow", "Enable gradual switch", "Open ticket with SRE".
Alex Chen: Implementation notes: routing policy change lives in route-manager. Need new column `compat_version_preference` (none / v1 / v2 / auto). Quota calc service must get a shadow_estimate field.
Priya Singh: Can you paste sample payload for shadow probe?
Alex Chen: ```json
{
  "tenant_id": "t_123",
  "routes": ["/v1/generate","/v1/chat"],
  "sample_pct": 0.5,
  "shadow_target": "v2-compat",
  "duration_hours": 24
}
```
Marcus Lopez: Small nit: sample_pct should be per-tenant per-route, default 0.1 for production. 0.5 is high.
Alex Chen: noted. default 0.1.
Priya Singh: Also need a subtle console banner copy to avoid alarming users: "We plan to move unversioned traffic to v2. Run a migration preview to see impact on your workloads." Include link to migration guide.
Dana Park: Add a changelog entry and a grace window policy doc (how we define "compatibility" and exceptions).
Marcus Lopez: Security question: will JWTs with legacy scopes be auto-switched? Some customers rely on the `x-client-version` header.
Alex Chen: We'll respect explicit headers. Auto-switch targets only tokens with no explicit version header. If a token has `x-client-version: v1` we'll route to v1 unless tenant sets `compat.auto_switch=true` and accepts shadow mode.
Priya Singh: Testing: need end-to-end tests for sticky session behavior, quota accounting, and fallback telemetry. Also load tests for the circuit breaker thresholds.
Alex Chen: I'll spin up a checklist in the migration RFC. Quick ask: can Eng-Platform own telemetry payload and the console scaffolding for the preview card?
Marcus Lopez: Eng-Platform + Eng-Releases can pair on migration rollout script. Ops will own the circuit breaker and runbook.
Dana Park: I'll draft the console copy and the enterprise opt-out UX.
Alex Chen: Thanks. Action items: 1) Marcus: circuit breaker thresholds & runbook (due EOD Fri). 2) Priya: telemetry metric names + dashboard mock (due Mon). 3) Dana: banner copy + opt-out flow (due Mon). 4) Me: RFC + route-manager PR.
ops-bot: deploy-notice: migration-preview-service v0.2 deployed to staging (build 2026-03-15-81).
Marcus Lopez: Saw staging deploy — ran a quick shadow sample against internal tenants, saw average token delta +6% on chat routes, -2% on embeddings. Will post numbers in docs.
Priya Singh: Perfect. Please tag the shadow_run_id in telem so we can validate alerts.
Alex Chen: Cool — reconnect tomorrow lunchtime for a short sync. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Dana Park: Thanks!
Priya Singh: Thanks :rocket:
